name: dev.tanod/tanod
title: Tanod
description: Pay-per-call tools for AI agents. Free daily allowance; x402 USDC. Remote or via npx.

environmentVariables.name: TANOD_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional EVM private key of a wallet holding USDC on Base, used to pay for calls beyond the free daily allowance via x402. Unset means free tier only.

environmentVariables.name: TANOD_MAX_USD_PER_CALL
environmentVariables.description: Refuse to sign any single payment above this many US dollars.

environmentVariables.name: TANOD_MAX_USD_PER_DAY
environmentVariables.description: Refuse to sign once the UTC-day total would exceed this many US dollars.
